import org.moqui.resource.ResourceReference import groovy.util.Node import groovy.json.JsonOutput
if (!artifactUri) return ResourceReference rr = ec.resource.getLocationReference(artifactUri) if (!rr || !rr.exists) return
rawXmlContent = rr.getText() groovy.xml.XmlParser parser = new XmlParser(false, false) parser.setFeature("http://apache.org/xml/features/nonvalidating/load-external-dtd", false) Node rootNode = parser.parseText(rawXmlContent)
def parseNodeToAst parseNodeToAst = { Node n -> Map nodeMap = [ name : n.name()?.toString(), attributes: n.attributes() ?: [:], children : [] ] String txt = n.text()?.trim() if (txt) nodeMap.text = txt
n.children().each { child -> if (child instanceof Node) { nodeMap.children.add(parseNodeToAst(child)) } } return nodeMap }
serviceAst = parseNodeToAst(rootNode)
